title: Dashboard enhancements and bug fixes
body:
* **Remove duplicate subscribers**: Dashboard authors can now remove duplicate subscribers from a dashboard schedule. See [Manage scheduled dashboard updates and subscriptions](/aws/en/dashboards/share/schedule-subscribe).
* **Import BI filters fix**: Fixed a bug where some filters were not created when importing Power BI and Tableau reports with Genie Code (`/importBI`). See [Import BI files using Genie Code](/aws/en/dashboards/manage/import-bi).
* **Reversed y-axis tooltip order fix**: Fixed a bug where tooltips for line and area charts with a reversed y-axis listed their series in the wrong order.
* **Duplicate schedule emails fix**: Fixed a bug where dashboard schedules could send duplicate emails to the same subscriber.
* **Pivot table None transform fix**: Fixed a bug where the None transform on pivot table values produced empty values.
